observation: V2 exact closure passed all four GPUs. N64 total-block reductions were 34.13/34.60/34.95/34.76 percent; N32 31.29/31.41/32.16/31.25. Both failed frozen 35 percent gate.
hypothesis: Copy only owned B/SFB vectors while preserving shared offsets, A/SFA staging, grid and arithmetic; remove the known duplicated-copy cost and achieve the unchanged 35 percent gate versus N128.
rivals: Duplicated N128 carrier staging overwhelms narrower compute ownership
Decode and synchronization dependency chains dominate rather than task count
Extra preparation/FC1 launch erases the gain
control: N128 small-M arithmetic from the c9edde image, in the same candidate image with narrow opt-in disabled
grid_geometry: Control dynamic grid64 with32 useful FC1 tasks; candidates separate preparation grid64 and FC1 grid128, with64 or128 useful tasks. Grid geometry changes alongside ownership; not an isolated tile-width causal test.
correctness_gate: All output, route-output, quantized-intermediate and input/scales must match N128 for each payload across five eager executions and five graph replays. M1 retains exact full raw buffers. M2/M3 input and scale rows are canonicalized on CPU by token_map logical pair id after checking row_counts, expert_tile_base and exact pair permutation; raw physical hashes retained. Fallback must explicitly resolve to small_m=false, fc1_tile_n=128. Every output finite. Random clipping stress is not exact threshold-boundary proof.
speed_gate: After complete correctness closure, five cyclic-order timing rounds of 100 CUDA graph samples per tile. Advance a tile to integrated TP4 only if its median total routed-block time is at least 35 percent lower than N128 on every physical GPU. Both tiles are developmental alternatives, not independent qualification wins.
experimental_unit: One prepared synthetic payload and image per physical GPU; eager repeats, graph replays and timing rounds are correlated subsamples, not independent server starts.
failure_policy: Preserve every compile/runtime/closure failure. Skip timing after any numerical failure and stop remaining GPUs after a device closure failure. No protected role retry. Any repair needs an explicit amended plan and fresh output path.
authorization: User authorized autonomous local codec optimization and agents; serialize GPU jobs under model-stack lock and restore prior service states.
codec_contract: K4 procedural MCG to E4M3, UE8M0/32, identity, 4.25 routed bpw; no LDLQ. P8 uses twice NVFP4 MMA issue count, not native P4 speed class.
